product_metadata.title: VASAGLE Computer Desk, 39-Inch Writing Study Desk for Home Office, Small Workstation with Iron Frame Top, Easy Assembly, Stable and Space-Saving, Industrial, Rustic Brown ULWD40X
features: Home Office Essential: Whether you’re a student who needs to study for an exam or a freelancer working from home, furnish your home office with this industrial style desk by VASAGLE so you can concentrate without any problems

Computers, Books, Printers: Thanks to its stable structure, this office desk, which consists of robust and durable particleboard and a 1. 2 mm thick iron frame with metal reinforcements, can hold the supplies you need to get your work done during the day

Easy Assembly: Why make things more complicated than they should be? This computer table consists of just a few individual parts; the side frame on both sides comes in one piece so assembly can be done in just a few simple steps

On a Level Surface: To help smooth out any unevenness and protect your floor from scratches, we’ve included adjustable feet on the bottom of the legs; now you can type away without your desk wobbling with your every movement
What You Get: A computer desk with a quality, rustic table top, stylish solid legs, clear instructions, and a chic industrial atmosphere in your room—all from our ALINRU Collection

details.Included Components: 1 x Computer Desk, 1 x Accessory Kit, 1 x Assembly Tool, 1 x Instructions
